_comment: #515 continuous-journey registry, read by qa/journey_gate.py. Every entry must exist in qa/manifest.json carrying the `journey` tier, and every manifest row carrying `journey` must be listed here, so content changes cannot silently drop a route. checkpoint = the dump_checkpoint slot the route must reach; budget_sec = serial headless wall time measured on the CI runner (run 37716072056: rogue 145, worker 164, martial 214, caster 126, imperfect 156 s) x ~1.5; local macOS runs take ~17-25 s.
